units.source_text: “K含含糊糊的回答，在第二天、第三天都明显地表现在他的神色中，看不出一点想主动谈论这个话题的样子。

en.t: K's vague reply was clearly reflected in his expression on the second and third days, and he showed no sign at all of wanting to bring up the subject himself.

units.source_text: 当然也是因为没有合适的机会。

en.t: Of course, that was also because there was no suitable opportunity.

units.source_text: 我心里很明白，如果夫人和小姐没有出门的话，我们俩是不可能有充裕的时间，仔细谈论这件事的。

en.t: I understood very well that unless the madam and the young lady went out, the two of us could not possibly have enough time to discuss the matter carefully.

units.source_text: 我虽然明白这个道理，却又莫名其妙地焦躁起来。

en.t: Although I understood this, I still became inexplicably restless.

units.source_text: 其结果是我一改原本打算等着对方提起，我接招的态度，竟下决心只要有机会，就主动开口。

en.t: As a result, I abandoned my original attitude of waiting for him to raise the matter and then responding, and instead resolved to speak first whenever the chance arose.

units.source_text: 同时，我悄悄地观察着家里人的动静，夫人的神情和小姐的举止跟以往没有什么不同。

en.t: At the same time, I quietly observed the movements of the household, but the madam's expression and the young lady's behavior were no different from before.

units.source_text: 在K向我倾吐对小姐的相思之前和之后，她们的表现没有发生什么变化的话，

en.t: If there was no change in how they acted before and after K confessed to me his love for the young lady,

units.source_text: 就说明他的表白对象仅限于我一个人，还没有跟小姐本人以及小姐的监护人夫人说起过。

en.t: then it meant that his confession had been made only to me, and that he had not yet spoken of it to the young lady herself or to her guardian, the madam.

units.source_text: 这样一想，我就踏实了些。

en.t: Thinking of it that way made me feel somewhat more at ease.

units.source_text: 于是，我又琢磨起来，与其勉强制造机会主动提起此事，不如抓住自然降临到我头上的机会更好一些。

en.t: So I began to think again that rather than forcing an opportunity and bringing the matter up myself, it would be better to seize the chance when it came to me naturally.

units.source_text: 我决定暂时把这个问题搁置一下。

en.t: I decided to set the matter aside for the time being.
